_comment: Baylight menu item icons: macOS 27 menus show a monochrome symbol beside each item, drawn here in the manner of SF Symbols' hierarchical rendering (a bright outline over a 30% body of the same ink), round caps and joins, slightly lighter pen than a toolbar glyph. Light ink so the icon reads on the dark menu (--menu) and on the blue highlight (--blue-deep). Exit and Remove in the accessible red, Favorites in systemYellow, Play in systemGreen. Render: node scripts/render-menu-icons.mjs Baylight --sheet
